thesis: Wintrust Financial (Nasdaq: WTFC). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-04) read in part (statements). Q3 NI 239.1M, 9M 700.1M vs 600.8M; 9M diluted EPS 9.89; Q3 EPS 3.37; Q3 net interest income 621.6M; provision Q3 25.9M, 9M 78.6M. Loans 56.80B vs 53.11B at year end (+7.0% in nine months); deposits 62.4B; allowance 401.7M (0.71% of loans, own calculation); assets 76.0B. TTM NI to common (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25) 889.7M. Equity 7,289.5M less preferred 425.0M, goodwill 804.7M and intangibles 110.0M = tangible common equity about 5,949.9M. Close 149.98 (2026-11-18) x 67,484,328 shares (10-Q cover, 2026-10-30) = 10.12B market cap = 11.4x TTM earnings to common and about 1.70x tangible common equity; TTM ROTCE about 15.0%. Price implies a high mid teens return on tangible equity with steady loan growth; against that, 1.7x tangible book is not demanding but 15% ROTCE already reflects strong earnings. Run 81 credit and capital read from the 10-Q MD&A: Q3 net interest margin 3.49% (3.48% a year earlier); nonperforming loans 176.9M (0.31% of 56.80B loans, own division) vs 162.6M a year earlier; nonperforming assets 193.3M; commercial real estate 14.96B (27% of loans, 62.5% in the Chicago area, nonperforming CRE 13.0M, 0.09%); net charge offs 21.0M in Q3 and 52.9M in 9M (annualized commercial 0.39% in Q3); total allowance for credit losses 485.8M; CET1 10.5%, Tier 1 capital 11.2%, leverage 9.8% (all above the 7.0% and 8.5% buffer thresholds shown). Credit looks clean so far; the 1.7x tangible book multiple already reflects it.
counterthesis: Loan growth of 7% in nine months with an allowance of only 0.71% of loans leaves less cushion if commercial real estate or specialty finance credit sours. CRE is 27% of loans with 62.5% concentrated in the Chicago area; nonperforming loans rose to 176.9M from 162.6M a year ago and net charge offs of 21.0M in Q3 were concentrated in commercial loans (0.39% annualized). The Northern Trust guardianship purchase was not found in the 10-Q text searched. A Northern Trust guardianship business purchase (tag dated 2026-09-01) has unread terms. Earnings rose partly with higher rates; margin sensitivity unverified. Equity reflects unrealized securities losses not examined. Peers (ZION, FNB, WAL, PNFP) not compared.
invalidation: Invalidated if nonperforming loans or net charge offs rise materially, loan growth outruns capital, NIM compresses with rate cuts, or ROTCE falls below about 12%.
